description: This is a C source file implementing a CoAP client using Zephyr RTOS, including socket setup, sending requests, handling responses, block-wise transfer, and observing notifications.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for an event on the poll file descriptors.

methods.name: prepare_fds
methods.description: Prepares the file descriptor set for polling.

methods.name: start_coap_client
methods.description: Initializes UDP socket and connects to the CoAP server.

methods.name: process_simple_coap_reply
methods.description: Receives and parses a simple CoAP reply.

methods.name: send_simple_coap_request
methods.description: Constructs and sends a CoAP request with specified method.

methods.name: send_simple_coap_msgs_and_wait_for_reply
methods.description: Sends multiple CoAP requests (GET, PUT, POST, DELETE) and processes replies.

methods.name: send_large_coap_request
methods.description: Sends a large block-wise CoAP request.

methods.name: get_large_coap_msgs
methods.description: Retrieves large CoAP messages using block-wise transfer.

methods.name: send_obs_reply_ack
methods.description: Sends acknowledgment for an observe notification.

methods.name: send_obs_reset_coap_request
methods.description: Sends a request to reset/unregister an observe.

methods.name: register_observer
methods.description: Registers as an observer and manages notifications.
